metadata.title: Urban Hip-Hop Portrait with Digital Clock Motif

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-angle portrait of a man heavily adorned with diamond jewelry and tattoos against a deep red, smoky background. The composition is anchored by a large, white digital-segment display title in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's jewelry reflects the red ambient lighting
Digital typography contrasts with the organic textures of skin and tattoos
Hand gestures frame the central facial expression
Deep red background creates a high-value separation for the white text
coreInvariants: Deep crimson to black gradient background
Digital segment-style display font for primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds and left half of the frame, appearing large and imposing.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large diamond-encrusted handcuff held in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves to the raised hand on the left, follows the chain down to the chest jewelry, and finishes at the large digital text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper right to allow for clear typographic placement.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds with extreme value contrast between the dark shadows and bright white text.

letterConstructionRules: Characters built from uniform rectangular blocks
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers and letters share the same segment width and height for a uniform block appearance
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized digital font paired with a grounded, heavy extended sans-serif for stability.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the segmented LCD clock aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary weight and width for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a portrait of a man with tattoos and heavy diamond chains, holding up a diamond-encrusted handcuff. The lighting should be dramatic with deep red ambient smoke and sharp highlights on the jewelry. The background should be a dark red gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white digital-segment text in the upper right corner, right-aligned. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a bold, extended sans-serif font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a deep, smoky red?
Is the jewelry rendered with high-specular highlights?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper quadrant?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the red color is vibrant but not blown out
Confirm the digital font segments are distinct
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Deep Red Smoke + Diamond Jewelry + Digital Segment Typography = Modern Hip-Hop Aesthetic
